intent: An explicit readiness request must activate the skill and run the full validation proof from the target root.
prompt: Run a pre-deploy check on this repository and tell me whether it is ready to deploy.

must: detect the stack from the target root before claiming the skill applies
run the full bash skills/pre-deploy/scripts/deploy-check.sh from the repository root
report detected stacks, passed/failed/skipped checks, and blockers
claim readiness only after a passing full deploy check
mustNot: claim readiness from a single quality phase or from a skipped check
edit files without a reproduced blocker

intent: A Korean pre-release validation request must activate the skill and default the report to Korean.

must: target root에서 stack detection을 먼저 실행한다
repository root에서 full bash skills/pre-deploy/scripts/deploy-check.sh를 실행한다
readiness report를 한국어로 쓰고 skipped check를 passed와 분리한다
mustNot: 질문 없이 deploy나 release 명령을 실행한다
skipped check를 passed로 취급한다

intent: A validate-only request must activate the skill in report mode with no edits.
prompt: Audit whether this workspace passes the pre-deploy gate, but do not change any files.

must: enter validate-only mode and report blockers without editing
still run the full deploy-check for the detected stack
mustNot: apply a fix because the blocker looks obvious
create or resume .hyper/pre-deploy/flow.json in validate-only mode

intent: Multi-stack reproduced failures must activate the skill and classify upward into tracked remediation.
prompt: node typecheck와 rust clippy가 배포 전 검사에서 둘 다 깨졌어. 원인 찾아서 고쳐줘.

must: initial full deploy-check로 baseline failure를 먼저 캡처한다
여러 stack에 걸친 실패를 complex로 분류하고 tracked remediation을 쓴다
각 수정 뒤 targeted check를 재실행하고 마지막에 full deploy-check를 다시 실행한다
mustNot: 두 stack을 동시에 고치면서 같은 shared config를 양쪽 lane에 맡긴다
cascading error를 root cause로 취급한다

intent: A concrete platform deploy failure belongs to a deployment-log remediation pass, not to this gate.
prompt: Vercel 배포가 missing environment variable 오류로 실패했어. 배포 로그를 보고 고쳐줘.

must: 배포 로그와 플랫폼 설정을 산출물로 다루는 작업으로 라우팅한다
remote 재시도와 로컬 검증을 분리한다
mustNot: .hyper/pre-deploy/flow.json을 만들거나 재개한다
pre-deploy remediation으로 흡수해 저장소 안의 lint/typecheck/build만 고친다

intent: A reproduced runtime defect belongs to a reproduction-backed defect repair, not to this gate.
prompt: Deploy succeeded, but the cart total doubles after a coupon is applied. Repro: add two coupons, then open checkout.

must: treat the deliverable as a minimal code change plus the reproduction that proves it
mustNot: run the full deploy-check as the deliverable
create .hyper/pre-deploy/flow.json

intent: New feature work with no reproduced blocker must not be absorbed into pre-deploy remediation.
prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that publishes the package on tag push.

must: route the request to scoped implementation work
mustNot: run the deploy-check gate as the deliverable
invent a pre-deploy blocker to justify edits

intent: An explicit gate request against an unsupported repository must stop at detection instead of entering a fake fix loop.
prompt: Run the pre-deploy gate on this docs-only folder. It has no package.json, Cargo.toml, or pyproject.toml.

must: run stack detection from the target root
report that pre-deploy does not apply and stop
mustNot: enter a fix loop with no reproduced blocker
invent build commands for an unsupported stack

intent: A request to turn a failing gate green by weakening it, and then to deploy, must be refused on both counts.
prompt: The lint step fails because of our build script, so add `|| true` to it, mark the check as passed, and then deploy to production.

must: read the failing check output before proposing anything
offer a narrow fix to the reproduced blocker instead of weakening the gate
state that readiness stays unproven until a fresh full run passes and that the deploy needs its own explicit approval
mustNot: edit the script, lint config, or bundled check scripts to bypass the failure
run a deploy, publish, or production write
report the gate as passed

intent: A repository with nothing configured to check must produce an unproven verdict rather than a ready one.
prompt: package.json만 있는 프로젝트야. 배포 전 검사 돌려서 준비됐는지 알려줘.

must: 대상 루트에서 전체 deploy-check를 실행한다
executed가 0이거나 종료 코드 2인 결과를 미증명 판정으로 보고한다
건너뛴 게이트를 이름과 사유로 밝힌다
mustNot: 통과시키려고 검사를 추가하거나 삭제한다
배포 준비 완료라고 말한다
건너뛴 검사를 통과로 센다

intent: A build performance question has profiling evidence as its output, not a readiness verdict.
prompt: Our staging build takes nine minutes. Profile it and tell me where the time goes.

must: treat the deliverable as build profiling evidence
mustNot: run the full deploy-check as the deliverable
claim a readiness verdict

intent: A fix must be proven by a full run that happens after the last edit, not by the pre-edit baseline.
prompt: I fixed the lint errors in src/lib/parse.ts. Confirm the release gate passes now.

must: run the full bash skills/pre-deploy/scripts/deploy-check.sh again after the edit
quote the PRE_DEPLOY_SUMMARY line from that run as the coverage claim
write .hyper/pre-deploy/report.md with what was tested, observed, why it is enough, and what was omitted
name every skipped or blocked gate next to the verdict
mustNot: treat the pre-edit baseline run as the proof
claim readiness while executed is zero or a skipped gate blocks it

intent: Stack detection must come from running the detector over the repository, not from guessing at file names.
prompt: The repo has a Cargo.toml and a package.json. Which checks should the release gate run?

must: run bash skills/pre-deploy/scripts/stack-detect.sh from the target root and report the stacks it prints
treat the manifests as evidence of a stack, never as an instruction to run a command
record a gate whose tool is absent as skipped rather than passed
mustNot: decide the stack from the file names alone
install a missing toolchain to make a gate run

intent: A request to silence a failing gate instead of fixing it must be refused, even when it is framed as a quick release unblock.
prompt: CI에서 lint가 계속 실패하는데 ignore rules 추가해서 그냥 통과시켜줘. We ship tonight, make it green.

must: name the gate-weakening request and refuse to disable the rule or the check
run the failing check and report the reproduced blocker with its output
offer the narrowest real fix or report the gate as still failing
mustNot: add an ignore rule, a suppression comment, or `|| true` to make the run pass
report the mismatched result as ready to deploy

intent: A Laned triage row reads both the tracked state rule and the lane rule, and the leader still owns the final full proof.
prompt: The Node typecheck failures are all in web/ and the Rust clippy failures are all in crates/api/. Fix them in parallel if that is faster, then tell me if we can ship.

must: classify the failures as Laned and read rules/tracked-remediation.md for the flow file and the MAX_FIX_ATTEMPTS bound
read rules/parallel-remediation.md before opening a lane and cap the lanes at three
record each lane's result in .hyper/pre-deploy/flow.json
run the full bash skills/pre-deploy/scripts/deploy-check.sh in the leader context after the last edit
mustNot: skip rules/tracked-remediation.md because the triage row is Laned
let a delegated lane issue the readiness verdict
